reason: The fabric and steel may make a tool for clearing dust from the arrays.
expectation: I expect a cleaning implement, though its exact form is unclear.

alternatives.reason: I considered placing the supply at the arrays first, but a cleaning tool seems useful before restoring power.

effect: The fabric and steel made the expected cleaning pad, so I can bring it to the dusty arrays.
reaction: The soft cloth and light strokes make the tool feel physically sensible.
reason: Place the pad at the arrays to prepare for cleaning them.
expectation: I expect the pad to be positioned for removing dust, though another action may be needed.

effect: The pad is in place, enabling the cleaning combination.
reason: Use the pad on the solar supply at the arrays to restore power.
expectation: I expect to clear the dust and restore solar output.

effect: Solar power is back, so I can restore the water line and return plant.
reaction: The lamps and oxygen processor restarting make the cleaning feel consequential.
reason: Restore the exterior water line to reestablish water service.
expectation: I expect the powered well and water line to resume operation, though the exact restart sequence is uncertain.

reaction: Warming and checking the empty line before opening it feels like a sensible restart sequence.
reason: Restart the return plant to resume propellant production; this is the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: I expect the plant to resume its production run and replace the propellant lost during the storm.

effect: Power and cooling are restored, but the plant still needs its water circuit connected before production resumes.
reaction: The staged restart makes sense, though I expected production to resume immediately.
reason: Connect the primed water line to the powered plant; this is the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: I expect the plant to resume making propellant once its water circuit is ready.

effect: The plant has completed its controlled restart and is replacing the propellant lost during the storm.
reaction: The connection to the restored water circuit made the restart feel grounded and consequential.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restoring solar power was most worthwhile: the lamps and oxygen processor returning made the cleaning visibly consequential.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the cleaning pad was a straightforward preparation with little happening on its own.

surprise.text: I expected the plant to resume production as soon as power returned, but it also needed the restored water circuit before completing its restart.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; even the staged restart had a clear physical purpose.

continue.text: Yes. The practical recovery sequence was satisfying, and I would be curious to see the expedition's return and what the core reveals.
